2115912877257138479.en_summary: Today's after hours is the ugliest print of Q3 earnings so far. Amazon, that small $2.7T company, wicked down 12% within seconds of the print. Intel went down 17%. Pinterest, Roblox, Reddit all down 15-20%. Then Binance rumors of getting hacked for $2B and BTC wicks below $79K for the first time since September. Ugly.
2115912877257138479.zh_summary: 今日盤後是迄今最醜陋的第三季財報反應。亞馬遜這家市值2.7兆美元的公司在財報公布後數秒內急跌12%。英特爾下跌17%。Pinterest、Roblox、Reddit均下跌15-20%。隨後幣安傳出被駭客盜取20億美元的傳聞，比特幣跌破7.9萬美元，為九月以來首次。醜陋。

2115912480983511271.en_summary: Lots of short term capital losses to harvest on the INTC and GOOG issuance. Also lets investors realize gains on other stuff.
2115912480983511271.zh_summary: 在英特爾和谷歌的發行上有大量短期資本損失可收割。同時也讓投資者實現其他資產的收益。

2115912211201761388.en_summary: The INTC (down 17% in after hours) guide down should not be extrapolated on NVDA (down 1.3%). Main issue is PC demand. If there is pricing pressure on DCAI it suggests they are likely losing share. Demand is slowing because of high memory costs. Nvidia has been beating numbers despite high memory costs and Jensen was bullish last week at GTC Berlin. SPCX, META, GOOG all said Capex in CY27 will be significantly higher than 2026. The Street is looking for 42% growth compared to 82% this year.
2115912211201761388.zh_summary: 英特爾（盤後下跌17%）的指引下調不應外推至英偉達（下跌1.3%）。主要問題是PC需求。如果DCAI有定價壓力，暗示可能正在失去份額。需求因高記憶體成本而放緩。英偉達一直在高記憶體成本下超預期，黃仁勳上週在GTC柏林表現樂觀。SpaceX、Meta、谷歌均表示2027年資本支出將顯著高於2026年。市場預期明年增長42%，而今年為82%。

ticker_notes.NVDA: 不應將英特爾PC需求問題外推，黃仁勳仍樂觀且資本支出展望正面
ticker_notes.INTC: 指引下調，PC需求放緩及可能失去份額
